title: Playboy Magazine November 1974 Poker Robert Sherrill Vintage
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue showing more wear than average. The left edge and spine have rubbing with small areas of surface paper loss, and there is chipping and creasing at the upper left and lower left corners. General edge wear and light scuffing across the dark cover. Please review the photos closely for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, November 1974 issue. Cover price $1.25.

Features:
- The annual film roundup - twelve pages
- Quick, Before You Go Broke! Everything You Ought to Know About Poker
- Robert Sherrill Looks for an Honest Politician - written in the year Nixon resigned

Boudoir cover with the vanity and mirror.

The back cover carries a 1974 Pall Mall Gold 100's ad, with the FTC figures dated March '74.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
